page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc6.8xlarge is a high clock speed, compute-oriented instance provisioned on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 3.1 GHz. The configuration allocates 32 dedicated vCPUs across 16 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled, accompanied by 35 MB of L3 cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and 32 KB of L1 data cache. The instance includes advanced instruction set extensions such as AVX-512 (including AVX512F and AVX512 VNNI), AES, and BMI2.

The instance delivers 64.0 GB of memory, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include bundled local storage or integrated hardware accelerators such as GPUs. Baseline network bandwidth is provisioned at 10 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are attached by default.

Benchmark results demonstrate balanced mid-range compute performance across standard workloads. The instance achieved a PassMark CPU score of 29,137.73, alongside Geekbench scores of 1,279.0 in single-core and 10,887.0 in multi-core metrics. Memory bandwidth reaches 104.96 GB/sec for large-block read operations and 36.58 GB/sec for write operations. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression processes at 139.27 GB/sec, while static web serving throughput is recorded at 20.59 GB/sec. For lightweight machine learning workloads, prompt processing reaches 1,563.07 tokens/sec on a 135M parameter model, falling to 46.11 tokens/sec on a 7B parameter model.

Because the ecs.hfc6.8xlarge relies entirely on external network-attached storage, I/O-intensive database workloads must account for network disk latency. Given its compute-heavy ratio and high base clock frequency, the instance offers cost-efficient compute density for applications requiring sustained CPU execution, such as Clang compilation pipelines, backend batch processing, web serving clusters, and CPU-based inference services.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc6.8xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features a 3.1 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor delivering 32 dedicated vCPUs (16 physical cores) and 64.0 GB of RAM, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory allocation. The CPU supports AVX-512 vector acceleration and AES encryption instructions. The instance does not include integrated GPUs or local storage, operating with 10 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth. Benchmark evaluations place the instance in the middle tier of multi-core compute and memory bandwidth, reaching a PassMark CPU score of 29,137.73 and a Geekbench multi-core rating of 10,887.0. With its 3.1 GHz clock speed and compute density, ecs.hfc6.8xlarge is designed for multi-threaded compilation tasks, high-throughput web serving, batch data processing, and lightweight CPU inference workloads relying on external network block volumes.
